# Display Toggle 1.0
The first public release.
## Highlights
- Disable and reconnect MacBook or external displays directly from the menu bar. - Disabled displays remain available so they can be turned on again. - Physical display arrivals and removals refresh automatically. - Audio follows the active display and remembers outputs connected through a display. - Audio already playing through a remaining active display is left unchanged. - Start the app automatically when you log in. - Try every feature free for 14 days without an account or payment card. - Purchase a $5 license directly from the menu or license window. - Automatically reconnect disabled displays when trial or license access ends. - Restore every inactive display from anywhere with Control–Option–Command–R. - Activate a purchased license on up to three personal Macs. - Receive signed automatic updates through Sparkle. - Available in 20 languages. - Native universal build for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
Requires macOS 13 Ventura or later. A purchase includes updates through Display Toggle 2.x.
## Compatibility note
Disconnecting a display changes the macOS desktop topology. macOS may briefly blank a remaining display while reapplying its display mode, especially when the main display is part of a Thunderbolt daisy chain. This is system display reconfiguration behavior and does not indicate that the cable was disconnected.
